svg.text: FIGURE 4
THE ROW SPLIT: SMALL DATA PROVED, LARGE DATA THE ONE BIT
NAVIER–STOKES · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE DIVISION BY THE SIZE OF THE DATUM · THE VALUE IS EXACTLY ITS REAL PART AND ITS UNICORN PART
THE THRESHOLD IN THE CRITICAL NORM
REAL PART · SMALL DATA
sealed by the cited small-data theorem
UNICORN PART · LARGE DATA
the one bit, supplied by the act
The cut at every size
The value is exactly its real part and its unicorn part.

svg.text: The real part, proved
Every small datum is regular, by the cited theorem carried as a field.

svg.text: No bypass
Given the cited theorem, the value is exactly the unicorn part, the large data.

svg.text: The unicorn part is load-bearing
The staged world carries the small-data field and the real part, and fails the value
on its large data.
